about_the_game:
Welcome to the eternal world!

Here players will play as a member of the hero squad. Legend has it that the them defeated the god of death that once flooded the world. And now,the hero was awakened by people's prayers and found that the world was facing a new threat. That is, the eternal God controls everything in a world without the god of death, bringing everything to a halt.

People were tortured by eternal immutability, so they once again turned to the legendary hero for help. This time the heroes will use the power of the god of death to restore the world to normal.

Obtain relics

Mysterious merchants collected powerful relics everywhere. At the end of each battle, she will appear and trade with you.

Use relics

Equip it on your chariot and strengthen the entire team.

Summon members

In battle, you can obtain enemy soul fragments and summon them to your team by consuming energy, bringing more possibilities.

Get information

At a loss? It's okay! The mouse stays on what you want to know, and it will tell you the information you need.

Face the challenge

In each game, there will be three different styles of scenes and corresponding enemies, a total of 20 normal battles and 3 boss battles and the final boss.

The enemy will come to you like a tide in battle. You need to match the relics and the team well, and adjust the position of the members or use skills without losing the opportunity to win in the end.
detailed_description:
About this demo

In the Ender Chariot Demo, players can experience the first character of the four - the Warrior!

Battle-hardened, he endured pain and fought bloodily, and growing up in the forest made him adept at using plants and clay to strengthen himself. Amidst endless slaughters, he sees the end of mortals. When he defeated the dragon and obtained the dragon's flesh and blood, he finally understood everything, and used his strong body to transcend the laws of reality and achieve a immortal self.

Players can face three hostile tribes and unlock the first three advanced challenges, but will not encounter the final enemy, the God of Eternal .

Don't take it lightly, though, these enemies are still very strong.

short_description: Ender Chariot is a relic-building roguelite game. You will choose one of four heroes to start a new adventure. Gather resources in battles, purchase relics, summon members, and form your unique chariot team. Charge through randomly areas with three different styles until victory.
